# The Unjournal

> The Unjournal provides rigorous, open peer evaluation of quantitative research informing global priorities — without the inefficiencies of traditional journals.

By The Unjournal (https://unjournal.org), a nonprofit that commissions public expert evaluations of impactful research. Published evaluations: https://unjournal.pubpub.org. About: https://info.unjournal.org

- [The Unjournal — Open Evaluation of Impactful Research](https://info.unjournal.org/)
